Explore the repository at /testbed. This is a Java Maven project called "memind". I need a thorough understanding of the memory subsystem. Specifically find and report file paths for:

1. The public `Memory` interface/class (likely `Memory.java`) — full path.
2. The `MemoryStore` interface — full path, and all its implementations (in-memory and MyBatis-backed).
3. The `MemoryId` class — full path.
4. The `MemoryItem` class (with `vectorId()` method) — full path.
5. The `MemoryInsight` class — full path.
6. The `MemoryInsightType` class — full path.
7. The `MemoryVector` class/interface — full path and any `deleteBatch` method signature.
8. The `MemoryRetriever` class/interface — full path and any `onDataChanged` method signature.
9. The `MemoryExtractor` class — full path.
10. Auto-configuration classes (Spring Boot) — specifically any `*AutoConfiguration.java` files that create a default `Memory` bean.
11. Any converters, initializers, tracing tests related to memory.
12. Any "default insight type" or taxonomy seeding code (search for keywords like "defaultInsightType", "taxonomy", "system memory", "SYSTEM" memory id).
13. Any MyBatis mapper XML files for memory items/insights/insight types.

Report all file paths found, grouped by category. Also report the current method signatures of `MemoryStore`, `MemoryVector`, and `MemoryRetriever` interfaces so I understand the current API shape. Report in under 500 words with concrete paths and signatures.

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

## Repository Exploration Report: memind Memory Subsystem

### 1–6. Core Data & API (memind-core, base path `/testbed/memind-core/src/main/java/com/openmemind/ai/memory/core/`)
- **Memory** (interface): `Memory.java`; impl: `DefaultMemory.java`
- **MemoryStore** (interface): `store/MemoryStore.java`
- **MemoryId**: `data/MemoryId.java` (plus `data/DefaultMemoryId.java` used by seeder)
- **MemoryItem** (record, has `vectorId` component): `data/MemoryItem.java`
- **MemoryInsight**: `data/MemoryInsight.java`
- **MemoryInsightType**: `data/MemoryInsightType.java`; also `data/DefaultInsightTypes.java`

### 2. MemoryStore implementations
- In-memory: `memind-core/.../core/store/InMemoryMemoryStore.java`
- MyBatis: `/testbed/memind-plugin/memind-plugin-store-mybatis-plus/src/main/java/com/openmemind/ai/memory/plugin/store/mybatis/MybatisPlusMemoryStore.java`
- Related: `MybatisPlusConversationBufferStore.java`, `MybatisPlusInsightBufferStore.java` (same dir)

### 7–9. Vector, Retrieval, Extraction
- **MemoryVector**: `memind-core/.../core/vector/MemoryVector.java` (impl: `SpringAiMemoryVector.java`)
- **MemoryRetriever**: `memind-core/.../core/retrieval/MemoryRetriever.java`
- **MemoryExtractor**: `memind-core/.../core/extraction/MemoryExtractor.java` (pipeline: `extraction/MemoryExtractionPipeline.java`)

### 10. Auto-configurations (`/testbed/memind-spring-boot-starter/src/main/java/com/openmemind/ai/memory/autoconfigure/`)
- `MemoryAutoConfiguration.java` — creates default `Memory` bean: `@Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean(Memory.class) public Memory memind(MemoryExtractionPipeline, MemoryRetriever, MemoryStore, ToolStatsService)` → `new DefaultMemory(...)`
- `MemoryRetrievalAutoConfiguration.java`, `vector/MemoryVectorAutoConfiguration.java`, `extraction/MemoryExtractionAutoConfiguration.java`; properties: `MemoryProperties.java`, `MemoryRetrievalProperties.java`, `MemoryExtractionProperties.java`
- Plugin: `mybatis/MemoryMybatisPlusAutoConfiguration.java`, `mybatis/mysql/MemoryMysqlAutoConfiguration.java`, `mybatis/sqlite/MemorySqliteAutoConfiguration.java`, tracing `otel/MemoryObserverAutoConfiguration.java`

### 11. Converters, initializers, tests
- Converters (`mybatis/converter/`): `ItemConverter.java`, `InsightConverter.java`, `InsightTypeConverter.java`, `RawDataConverter.java`, `ConversationBufferConverter.java`
- Initializer (`mybatis/initializer/`): `DefaultTaxonomySeeder.java`, `MemoryStoreProperties.java`
- Tests: `mybatis/MemoryStoreAutoConfigurationTest.java`, `mybatis/MybatisPlusMemoryStoreBatchOperationsTest.java`; starter tests `MemoryAutoConfigurationTest.java`, `MemoryRetrievalAutoConfigurationTest.java`, `vector/MemoryVectorAutoConfigurationTest.java`, `extraction/MemoryExtractionAutoConfigurationTest.java`; tracing tests: `otel/InsightPipelineTracingTest.java`, `otel/OpenTelemetryMemoryObserverTest.java`, `otel/TracingBeanPostProcessorTest.java`

### 12. Taxonomy seeding
`DefaultTaxonomySeeder` (ApplicationListener<ApplicationStartedEvent>): uses `MemoryId systemMemoryId = DefaultMemoryId.of("system", "system")` then `DefaultInsightTypes.all().forEach(t -> memoryStore.saveInsightType(systemMemoryId, t))`. Migration: `src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init_mysql_store.sql`.

### 13. MyBatis mapper XMLs
**None exist.** MyBatis-Plus annotation-based mappers only (`mybatis/mapper/`): `MemoryItemMapper.java`, `MemoryInsightMapper.java`, `MemoryInsightTypeMapper.java`, `MemoryRawDataMapper.java`.
